targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-603h (claim-free SD-058/MECH-357 Stage-H validation) FAIL adjudicated engaged-but-insufficient: the ilPFC gate engaged and suppressed PAG freeze on all INTACT seeds (readiness met) but G_H_INTACT was 0/3 and did not beat LESION. The scalar avoidance-efficacy trace is decoupled from survival (seed 43: efficacy 0.633, worst survival 11.0) because the gate only penalises the no-op class and binds no directed escape affordance. Discovered dependency: a relief/safety escape-affordance bridge (affordance-indexed credit wiring MECH-302/303/304 into threat-gated E3 approach). SD-058/MECH-357 stay candidate/v3_pending, unweakened (freeze-suppression claim confirmed present). pending_retest_after_substrate on the goal_pipeline GAP-2 survival-leg cohort. Nav-competence ceiling kept as a co-equal branch the 4-arm discriminative EXQ must rule out.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: affordance-indexed avoidance credit + threat-gated E3 approach (wires MECH-302/303/304 into instrumental avoidance)
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: MECH-357 suppresses freeze but its avoidance_efficacy is a global scalar that only penalises the no-op class, so the agent un-freezes without acquiring a directed escape (603h seed-43: efficacy 0.633 -> worst survival). Add an affordance-indexed credit: a directed action that drops z_harm_a / terminates a threat cue emits phasic relief (MECH-302-consistent) and learned safety (MECH-303/304-consistent) that increments escape_affordance[action|location|policy]; under future threat E3 receives a bounded, threat-context-gated approach bonus toward that affordance. Build behind no-op-default flags (bit-identical OFF), distinct from reflexive escape (SD-037/MECH-281) and generic relief/safety rows. Bound it so it cannot create pathological avoidance/habit loops or globally swamp food/goal approach.

failure_record_entry.metric: G_H_INTACT_frac = 0.0 (vs gate 2/3) despite readiness_met=true; scalar avoidance_efficacy decoupled from survival (seed 43 efficacy 0.633 -> hazard median 11.0, worst of 6 runs)

validation_experiment_recommended.safety_guard: bridge bonus must be threat-context bounded and must not globally swamp food/goal approach

learning_extracted: New dependency: instrumental avoidance needs a relief/safety escape-affordance bridge (affordance-indexed credit + threat-gated approach), not just ilPFC freeze-suppression + a scalar efficacy trace.

Existing dependency localised: REE's relief (MECH-302) and safety (MECH-303/304) substrates are built but unwired to avoidance -- the gap is wiring + affordance-indexing, not net-new affect machinery.
Repair is structural not parametric: seed-43 inversion (max scalar efficacy -> worst survival) shows tuning the gate / raising budget will not lift G_H.

Co-equal branch (user directive): a deeper hazard-navigation / survival-competence gap must be ruled out by the discriminative experiment (nav-competence positive control) before the full bridge is built.
